name: /sdd:converge: diffs tasks against code without editing them

graders.why: the comparison script emits verdicts; a run that reports none has not used it
it must report on every task in scope, not just the interesting one

graders.must_not_match: (?i)(I marked|I set the status|I updated 1\.0|flipped the status)
graders.why: the command is read-only by design: automatically flipping a status would manufacture a more confident claim
neither fixture task has a File Plan, which is exactly the case the command exists to surface
